# GenOS

> Counterfactual, biomimetic runtime for multi-agent execution: branches, snapshots, budgets, evidence gates and recovery.

GenOS V3 is a polyglot monorepo:
- Rust workspace in `crates/` (runtime core: cell, biology, orchestrator, store, MCP, CLI).
- Node.js control plane in `backend/` (Express REST + gRPC, SQLite WAL, MCP tool registry).
- stdio MCP server in `mcp/` exposing leased tools to MCP clients.
- Technical documentation in `docs/` (French).

Core rule: a successful transport is NOT proof of a valid decision. Respect the evidence and promotion gates; never fake success.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/PISSARAW/GenOS/blob/v3/README.md): product overview, architecture and quickstart.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/PISSARAW/GenOS/blob/v3/AGENTS.md): build, test, lint gates and conventions for coding agents.
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/PISSARAW/GenOS/blob/v3/docs/README.md): full doc map and reading paths.
- [Backend README](https://github.com/PISSARAW/GenOS/blob/v3/backend/README.md): REST/gRPC control plane and subsystems.

- [docs/EPISTEMOLOGIE_EVIDENCE.md](https://github.com/PISSARAW/GenOS/blob/v3/docs/EPISTEMOLOGIE_EVIDENCE.md): evidence, belief state and "success is not truth".

## Notes for agents

- Definition of done: `python scripts/ci/check_code_quality.py`, `npm test`, `cargo test --workspace`.
- Code gate: max 400 lines/file, max 3 parameters/function, cyclomatic complexity <= 10, ADR required for architecture changes (`.genos.md`).
- The MCP server must be launched from the repository root (`node mcp/index.js`) and is gated by `GENOS_MCP_LEASE` / `GENOS_MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS`.
- Never commit `.env`, secrets, `*.db` or generated artifacts.
